rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a rescue operation or episode of saving someone.

example.jyutping: gau3 wun4 zung1 jyu1 dou3 zo2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saving someone from danger or harm.

example.english: The firefighters finally rescue the man who fell into the sea.
example.traditional: 消防員終於救咗嗰個跌落海嘅男人。
example.jyutping: siu1 fong4 jyun4 zung1 jyu1 gau3 zo2 go2 go3 dit3 lok6 hoi2 ge3 naam4 jan4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing getting someone out of confinement or physical restraint.

example.english: We finally rescue the passengers trapped in the lift.
example.traditional: 我哋終於救出困喺升降機入面嘅乘客。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 gau3 ceot1 kwan3 hai2 sing1 gong3 gei1 jap6 min6 ge3 sing4 haak3

rows.jyutping: bei2 jan4 gau3 zo2 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this colloquial construction for a person or animal that someone has rescued.

example.english: This cat is a rescue and is lively again.
example.traditional: 呢隻畀人救咗嘅貓而家好精神。
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 bei2 jan4 gau3 zo2 ge3 maau1 ji4 gaa1 hou2 zing1 san4

rows.note: Use this formal noun for a rescued person, especially in written or official contexts.

example.english: The rescuee was taken to hospital after the rescue.
example.traditional: 獲救者喺救援後已經送院。
example.jyutping: wok6 gau3 ze2 hai2 gau3 wun4 hau6 ji5 ging1 sung3 jyun2
